text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Alright Trainer-san,
I'll do my best to play the villain today~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's go.
Time for the supervillain to make her entrance!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Creek! Creek! Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, a massive chorus?
Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's enough of this cheap farce,
Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tama-chan... Oguri-chan...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The people who learned about you watched
your past races. ...On UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone knows. Just how wonderful of an Umamusume Creek is.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is! So playing the villain is over.
Nobody thinks Creek's the bad guy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You didn't work this hard
just to rule as the Evil Queen, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek! Tell everyone what you
came all the way out here to do!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I came here to become
the strongest Umamusume. And then--

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To make you the greatest trainer in the world!
That is my one and only dream!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah... Aah~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I actually said it...
In front of... all these people~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's fine, that works.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, it's a place to clash with genuine, 100% seriousness.
Ain't no time to be shy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let us compete.
And test the strength of our respective dreams.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Preparations are complete. The stage where we bet everything the two of us have built together awaits.
